announcements.title: ⚠️ Official website format change — timetable temporarily unavailable
announcements.message: The college's official website has recently changed its timetable format, which has caused NextLecture's timetable fetching functionality to fail unexpectedly. We are working on a prompt fix and will restore automatic timetable updates as soon as possible. In the meantime, please refer to the official college website for the latest timetable.

announcements.title: ⚠️ Submit original documents by 9 September
announcements.message: All students must submit their original documents to the college administrative office by 9 September for verification. Please bring the required documents during office hours to complete your registration. Failure to submit documents on time may affect your enrollment status.
